+
+def _require_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(value: Any, *, field: str, optional: bool = False) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        if optional:
+            return None
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is required")
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        result = value
+    elif isinstance(value, int):
+        result = Decimal(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            result = Decimal(value.strip())
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if not result.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    return result
+
+
+def _timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty timestamp or date")
+    text = value.strip()
+    if len(text) == 10:
+        try:
+            parsed_date = Date.fromisoformat(text)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid date") from None
+        return datetime.combine(parsed_date, datetime.min.time(), tzinfo=UTC)
+    if text.endswith("Z"):
+        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _activity_time(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> datetime:
+    for name in ("transaction_time", "executed_at", "at", "date", "settle_date"):
+        if data.get(name) is not None:
+            return _timestamp(data[name], field=name)
+    raise ValueError("activity has no transaction_time or date")
+
+
+def _optional_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    return _require_text(value, field=field)
+
+
+def activity_idempotency_key(
+    activity_id: str,
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str,
+    fingerprint: str | None = None,
+    *,
+    account_fingerprint: str | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    """Return a stable scope-qualified key for one broker activity ID."""
+
+    broker_id = _require_text(activity_id, field="activity_id")
+    raw_environment = getattr(environment, "value", environment)
+    environment_name = _require_text(raw_environment, field="environment").upper()
+    if environment_name not in {member.value for member in AlpacaEnvironment}:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported Alpaca environment: {environment_name!r}")
+    if fingerprint is not None and account_fingerprint is not None:
+        if fingerprint != account_fingerprint:
+            raise ValueError("fingerprint and account_fingerprint disagree")
+    scope = fingerprint if fingerprint is not None else account_fingerprint
+    resolved_fingerprint = _require_text(scope, field="fingerprint")
+    # Length prefixes make the representation unambiguous while retaining the
+    # broker ID and account scope for operator inspection.
+    return (
+        f"alpaca:{len(environment_name)}:{environment_name}:"
+        f"{len(resolved_fingerprint)}:{resolved_fingerprint}:"
+        f"{len(broker_id)}:{broker_id}"
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class FillActivity:
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    idempotency_key: str
+    id: str
+    order_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    side: str
+    qty: Decimal
+    cum_qty: Decimal
+    leaves_qty: Decimal
+    price: Decimal
+    transaction_time: datetime
+    type: str
+    activity_type: str = "FILL"
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class FeeActivity:
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    idempotency_key: str
+    id: str
+    activity_type: str
+    amount: Decimal
+    transaction_time: datetime
+    symbol: str | None = None
+    qty: Decimal | None = None
+    price: Decimal | None = None
+    description: str | None = None
+    activity_sub_type: str | None = None
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CorporateActivity:
+    """A dividend or position-changing corporate action.
+
+    Corporate actions have heterogeneous payloads.  Common numeric values are
+    normalized explicitly and ``amounts`` preserves any additional documented
+    amount/quantity/price fields as Decimal values.
+    """
+
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    idempotency_key: str
+    id: str
+    activity_type: str
+    transaction_time: datetime
+    symbol: str | None = None
+    amount: Decimal | None = None
+    qty: Decimal | None = None
+    price: Decimal | None = None
+    per_share_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    description: str | None = None
+    activity_sub_type: str | None = None
+    is_dividend: bool = False
+    amounts: Mapping[str, Decimal] | None = None
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class UnknownActivity:
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    idempotency_key: str
+    id: str
+    activity_type: str
+    transaction_time: datetime | None
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any]
+
+
+NormalizedActivity = FillActivity | FeeActivity | CorporateActivity | UnknownActivity
+
+
+def dedupe_activities(activities: Iterable[NormalizedActivity]) -> list[NormalizedActivity]:
+    """Pure, stable-order deduplication by normalized idempotency key."""
+
+    result: list[NormalizedActivity] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for activity in activities:
+        key = activity.idempotency_key
+        if key not in seen:
+            seen.add(key)
+            result.append(activity)
+    return result
+
+
+def _all_decimal_fields(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
+    markers = ("amount", "qty", "quantity", "price", "cash", "rate", "ratio", "fee")
+    values: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
+    for name, value in data.items():
+        if value is None or not any(marker in name.lower() for marker in markers):
+            continue
+        try:
+            parsed = _decimal(value, field=name, optional=True)
+        except ValueError:
+            continue
+        if parsed is not None:
+            values[name] = parsed
+    return values
+
+
+class AlpacaActivityService:
+    """Read and normalize bounded pages from ``GET /v2/account/activities``."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        client: Any,
+        *,
+        environment: AlpacaEnvironment | None = None,
+        fingerprint: str | None = None,
+        page_size: int = 100,
+        max_pages: int = 10,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(client, "get", None)):
+            raise TypeError("client must expose get(path, params=...)")
+        resolved_environment = environment or getattr(client, "environment", None)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
+            raise TypeError("environment must be supplied or exposed by the client")
+        resolved_fingerprint = fingerprint or getattr(client, "fingerprint", None)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_fingerprint, str) or not resolved_fingerprint.strip():
+            raise ValueError("fingerprint must be supplied or exposed by the client")
+        self._validate_page_size(page_size)
+        self._validate_max_pages(max_pages)
+        self._client = client
+        self._environment = resolved_environment
+        self._fingerprint = resolved_fingerprint.strip()
+        self._page_size = page_size
+        self._max_pages = max_pages
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_page_size(page_size: int) -> None:
+        if (
+            isinstance(page_size, bool)
+            or not isinstance(page_size, int)
+            or not 1 <= page_size <= 100
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("page_size must be an int from 1 through 100")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_max_pages(max_pages: int) -> None:
+        if isinstance(max_pages, bool) or not isinstance(max_pages, int) or max_pages < 1:
+            raise ValueError("max_pages must be an int >= 1")
+
+    @property
+    def environment(self) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
+        return self._environment
+
+    @property
+    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
+        return self._fingerprint
+
+    def normalize_activity(self, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> NormalizedActivity:
+        if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("activity must be a JSON object")
+        activity_id = _require_text(data.get("id"), field="id")
+        activity_type = _require_text(data.get("activity_type"), field="activity_type").upper()
+        idempotency_key = activity_idempotency_key(
+            activity_id, self._environment, self._fingerprint
+        )
+        raw = dict(data)
+        if activity_type == "FILL":
+            fill_type = _require_text(data.get("type"), field="type").lower()
+            if fill_type not in {"fill", "partial_fill"}:
+                raise ValueError(f"unsupported FILL type: {fill_type!r}")
+            return FillActivity(
+                environment=self._environment,
+                fingerprint=self._fingerprint,
+                idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
+                id=activity_id,
+                order_id=_require_text(data.get("order_id"), field="order_id"),
+                symbol=_require_text(data.get("symbol"), field="symbol").upper(),
+                side=_require_text(data.get("side"), field="side").lower(),
+                qty=_decimal(data.get("qty"), field="qty"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                cum_qty=_decimal(data.get("cum_qty"), field="cum_qty"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                leaves_qty=_decimal(data.get("leaves_qty"), field="leaves_qty"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                price=_decimal(data.get("price"), field="price"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                transaction_time=_activity_time(data),
+                type=fill_type,
+                raw=raw,
+            )
+
+        amount = data.get("net_amount", data.get("amount", data.get("fee")))
+        if activity_type in _FEE_TYPES:
+            return FeeActivity(
+                environment=self._environment,
+                fingerprint=self._fingerprint,
+                idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
+                id=activity_id,
+                activity_type=activity_type,
+                amount=_decimal(amount, field="net_amount"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                transaction_time=_activity_time(data),
+                symbol=_optional_text(data.get("symbol"), field="symbol"),
+                qty=_decimal(data.get("qty"), field="qty", optional=True),
+                price=_decimal(data.get("price"), field="price", optional=True),
+                description=_optional_text(data.get("description"), field="description"),
+                activity_sub_type=_optional_text(
+                    data.get("activity_sub_type", data.get("activity_subtype")),
+                    field="activity_sub_type",
+                ),
+                raw=raw,
+            )
+
+        if activity_type in _DIVIDEND_TYPES | _CORPORATE_TYPES:
+            symbol = _optional_text(data.get("symbol"), field="symbol")
+            return CorporateActivity(
+                environment=self._environment,
+                fingerprint=self._fingerprint,
+                idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
+                id=activity_id,
+                activity_type=activity_type,
+                transaction_time=_activity_time(data),
+                symbol=None if symbol is None else symbol.upper(),
+                amount=_decimal(amount, field="net_amount", optional=True),
+                qty=_decimal(data.get("qty"), field="qty", optional=True),
+                price=_decimal(data.get("price"), field="price", optional=True),
+                per_share_amount=_decimal(
+                    data.get("per_share_amount"), field="per_share_amount", optional=True
+                ),
+                description=_optional_text(data.get("description"), field="description"),
+                activity_sub_type=_optional_text(
+                    data.get("activity_sub_type", data.get("activity_subtype")),
+                    field="activity_sub_type",
+                ),
+                is_dividend=activity_type in _DIVIDEND_TYPES,
+                amounts=_all_decimal_fields(data),
+                raw=raw,
+            )
+
+        return UnknownActivity(
+            environment=self._environment,
+            fingerprint=self._fingerprint,
+            idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
+            id=activity_id,
+            activity_type=activity_type,
+            transaction_time=(
+                _activity_time(data)
+                if any(
+                    data.get(name) is not None
+                    for name in ("transaction_time", "executed_at", "at", "date", "settle_date")
+                )
+                else None
+            ),
+            raw=raw,
+        )
+
+    def list_activities(
+        self,
+        *,
+        activity_types: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
+        activity_type: str | None = None,
+        date: str | Date | datetime | None = None,
+        after: str | Date | datetime | None = None,
+        until: str | Date | datetime | None = None,
+        direction: str | None = None,
+        order_id: str | None = None,
+        page_size: int | None = None,
+        max_pages: int | None = None,
+    ) -> list[NormalizedActivity]:
+        """Read activities using page tokens, stopping at the hard page cap."""
+
+        if activity_types is not None and activity_type is not None:
+            raise ValueError("pass activity_types or activity_type, not both")
+        resolved_page_size = self._page_size if page_size is None else page_size
+        resolved_max_pages = self._max_pages if max_pages is None else max_pages
+        self._validate_page_size(resolved_page_size)
+        self._validate_max_pages(resolved_max_pages)
+        params: dict[str, Any] = {"page_size": resolved_page_size}
+        chosen_types: str | Sequence[str] | None = (
+            activity_types if activity_types is not None else activity_type
+        )
+        if chosen_types is not None:
+            if isinstance(chosen_types, str):
+                normalized_types = _require_text(chosen_types, field="activity_types").upper()
+            else:
+                normalized_types = ",".join(
+                    _require_text(item, field="activity_types item").upper()
+                    for item in chosen_types
+                )
+                if not normalized_types:
+                    raise ValueError("activity_types must not be empty")
+            params["activity_types"] = normalized_types
+        for name, value in (("date", date), ("after", after), ("until", until)):
+            if value is not None:
+                params[name] = self._format_filter(value, field=name)
+        if direction is not None:
+            normalized_direction = _require_text(direction, field="direction").lower()
+            if normalized_direction not in {"asc", "desc"}:
+                raise ValueError("direction must be 'asc' or 'desc'")
+            params["direction"] = normalized_direction
+        if order_id is not None:
+            params["order_id"] = _require_text(order_id, field="order_id")
+
+        result: list[NormalizedActivity] = []
+        previous_token: str | None = None
+        for _page_number in range(resolved_max_pages):
+            response = self._client.get("/v2/account/activities", params=dict(params))
+            items, explicit_token = self._page(response)
+            result.extend(self.normalize_activity(item) for item in items)
+            if explicit_token is not None:
+                next_token = explicit_token
+            elif len(items) < resolved_page_size:
+                break
+            elif items:
+                next_token = _require_text(items[-1].get("id"), field="last activity id")
+            else:
+                break
+            if next_token == previous_token:
+                raise ValueError("activity pagination repeated a page token")
+            previous_token = next_token
+            params["page_token"] = next_token
+        return result
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _format_filter(value: str | Date | datetime, *, field: str) -> str:
+        if isinstance(value, datetime):
+            if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{field} datetime must be timezone-aware")
+            return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        if isinstance(value, Date):
+            return value.isoformat()
+        return _require_text(value, field=field)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _page(response: Any) -> tuple[list[Mapping[str, Any]], str | None]:
+        token: str | None = None
+        if isinstance(response, list):
+            items = response
+        elif isinstance(response, Mapping):
+            candidate = response.get("activities", response.get("data"))
+            if not isinstance(candidate, list):
+                raise ValueError("activity response object must contain an activities array")
+            items = candidate
+            raw_token = response.get("next_page_token")
+            if raw_token is not None:
+                token = _require_text(raw_token, field="next_page_token")
+        else:
+            raise ValueError("GET /v2/account/activities must return a JSON array")
+        if not all(isinstance(item, Mapping) for item in items):
+            raise ValueError("account activity entries must be JSON objects")
+        return items, token

+"""Normalize Alpaca ``trade_updates`` and manage a read-only stream session.
+
+The websocket transport is injected and intentionally tiny, allowing contract
+tests to replay JSON without opening a socket.  This module sends only Alpaca's
+authentication and ``listen`` frames; it has no order mutation operations.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import inspect
+import json
+import math
+import random
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.auth import (
+    AlpacaCredentials,
+    AlpacaEnvironment,
+    EnvironmentMismatchError,
+    credential_fingerprint,
+)
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.orders import AlpacaOrder, _normalize_order
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import BrokerError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "TradeUpdate",
+    "TradeUpdateEvent",
+    "TradeUpdateStream",
+    "StreamReconnected",
+    "StreamAuthError",
+    "ReconnectPolicy",
+]
+
+
+class TradeUpdateEvent(StrEnum):
+    NEW = "new"
+    ACCEPTED = "accepted"
+    PENDING_NEW = "pending_new"
+    PARTIAL_FILL = "partial_fill"
+    FILL = "fill"
+    REJECTED = "rejected"
+    CANCELED = "canceled"
+    EXPIRED = "expired"
+    REPLACED = "replaced"
+    PENDING_CANCEL = "pending_cancel"
+    PENDING_REPLACE = "pending_replace"
+    DONE_FOR_DAY = "done_for_day"
+    STOPPED = "stopped"
+    SUSPENDED = "suspended"
+    CALCULATED = "calculated"
+    UNKNOWN = "unknown"
+
+
+_KNOWN_EVENTS = {
+    member.value: member
+    for member in TradeUpdateEvent
+    if member is not TradeUpdateEvent.UNKNOWN
+}
+
+
+def _require_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _optional_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    return _require_text(value, field=field)
+
+
+def _decimal(value: Any, *, field: str) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        result = value
+    elif isinstance(value, int):
+        result = Decimal(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            result = Decimal(value.strip())
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if not result.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    return result
+
+
+def _timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str = "timestamp") -> datetime:
+    text = _require_text(value, field=field)
+    if text.endswith("Z"):
+        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _environment(value: Any) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    text = _require_text(raw, field="environment").upper()
+    try:
+        return AlpacaEnvironment(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise EnvironmentMismatchError(f"unknown Alpaca stream environment {text!r}") from None
+
+
+def _decode_message(message: Any) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(message, bytes):
+        message = message.decode("utf-8")
+    if isinstance(message, str):
+        try:
+            message = json.loads(message, parse_float=Decimal, parse_int=Decimal)
+        except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError):
+            raise ValueError("websocket message is not valid JSON") from None
+    if not isinstance(message, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError("websocket message must be a JSON object")
+    return message
+
+
+def _payload(message: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    stream_name = message.get("stream", message.get("T"))
+    data = message.get("data")
+    if stream_name == "trade_updates":
+        if data is None:
+            return message
+        if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("trade_updates data must be a JSON object")
+        return data
+    # Accept an already-unwrapped fixture or transport payload.
+    if "event" in message and "order" in message:
+        return message
+    raise ValueError("message is not a trade_updates event")
+
+
+def _assert_message_scope(
+    message: Mapping[str, Any],
+    data: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment,
+    fingerprint: str,
+) -> None:
+    order = data.get("order")
+    sources = [message, data]
+    if isinstance(order, Mapping):
+        sources.append(order)
+    for source in sources:
+        for name in ("environment", "account_environment", "source_environment"):
+            if source.get(name) is not None and _environment(source[name]) is not environment:
+                raise EnvironmentMismatchError(
+                    f"trade update environment {source[name]!r} does not match "
+                    f"session environment {environment.value}"
+                )
+        for name in ("fingerprint", "account_fingerprint"):
+            if source.get(name) is not None and source[name] != fingerprint:
+                raise EnvironmentMismatchError(
+                    "trade update account fingerprint does not match stream session"
+                )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class TradeUpdate:
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    event: TradeUpdateEvent
+    raw_event: str
+    order: AlpacaOrder
+    timestamp: datetime
+    execution_id: str | None = None
+    price: Decimal | None = None
+    qty: Decimal | None = None
+    position_qty: Decimal | None = None
+    reason: str | None = None
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_message(
+        cls,
+        message: Mapping[str, Any] | str | bytes,
+        *,
+        environment: AlpacaEnvironment,
+        fingerprint: str,
+    ) -> TradeUpdate:
+        """Normalize one envelope (or already-unwrapped) trade update."""
+
+        if not isinstance(environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
+            raise TypeError("environment must be an AlpacaEnvironment")
+        resolved_fingerprint = _require_text(fingerprint, field="fingerprint")
+        envelope = _decode_message(message)
+        data = _payload(envelope)
+        _assert_message_scope(
+            envelope,
+            data,
+            environment=environment,
+            fingerprint=resolved_fingerprint,
+        )
+        raw_event = _require_text(data.get("event"), field="event").lower()
+        event = _KNOWN_EVENTS.get(raw_event, TradeUpdateEvent.UNKNOWN)
+        raw_order = data.get("order")
+        if not isinstance(raw_order, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("trade update order must be a JSON object")
+        return cls(
+            environment=environment,
+            fingerprint=resolved_fingerprint,
+            event=event,
+            raw_event=raw_event,
+            order=_normalize_order(raw_order, environment=environment),
+            timestamp=_timestamp(data.get("timestamp")),
+            execution_id=_optional_text(data.get("execution_id"), field="execution_id"),
+            price=_decimal(data.get("price"), field="price"),
+            qty=_decimal(data.get("qty"), field="qty"),
+            position_qty=_decimal(data.get("position_qty"), field="position_qty"),
+            reason=_optional_text(data.get("reason"), field="reason"),
+            raw=dict(envelope),
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def is_unknown(self) -> bool:
+        return self.event is TradeUpdateEvent.UNKNOWN
+
+    @property
+    def incremental_qty(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        """Execution quantity in this message (distinct from order.filled_qty)."""
+
+        return self.qty
+
+    @property
+    def cumulative_qty(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        return self.order.filled_qty
+

+class StreamAuthError(BrokerError):
+    """Alpaca rejected websocket authentication or the listen request."""
+
+    def __init__(self, message: str, *, response: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
+        self.response = None if response is None else dict(response)
+        super().__init__(message, code="alpaca_stream_auth", context={})

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ReconnectPolicy:
+    """Maximum reconnect attempts and bounded exponential delay with jitter."""
+
+    max_attempts: int = 5
+    base_delay_seconds: float = 0.5
+    max_delay_seconds: float = 8.0
+    jitter_ratio: float = 0.25
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if isinstance(self.max_attempts, bool) or not isinstance(self.max_attempts, int):
+            raise ValueError("max_attempts must be an int >= 1")
+        if self.max_attempts < 1:
+            raise ValueError("max_attempts must be an int >= 1")
+        for name in ("base_delay_seconds", "max_delay_seconds", "jitter_ratio"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite non-negative number")
+            if not math.isfinite(float(value)) or value < 0:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite non-negative number")
+        if self.max_delay_seconds < self.base_delay_seconds:
+            raise ValueError("max_delay_seconds must be >= base_delay_seconds")
+        if self.jitter_ratio > 1:
+            raise ValueError("jitter_ratio must be <= 1")
+
+    def delay_for_attempt(
+        self, attempt: int, rng: Callable[[], float] | None = None
+    ) -> float:
+        if isinstance(attempt, bool) or not isinstance(attempt, int) or attempt < 1:
+            raise ValueError("attempt must be an int >= 1")
+        base = min(
+            float(self.max_delay_seconds),
+            float(self.base_delay_seconds) * (2.0 ** (attempt - 1)),
+        )
+        if rng is not None and self.jitter_ratio:
+            draw = float(rng())
+            if not math.isfinite(draw) or not 0 <= draw <= 1:
+                raise ValueError("rng must return a finite value from 0 through 1")
+            base *= 1.0 + float(self.jitter_ratio) * (2.0 * draw - 1.0)

+class TradeUpdateStream:
+    """Authenticate, listen, normalize, and reconnect an injected transport."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        credentials: AlpacaCredentials,
+        transport: Any,
+        *,
+        environment: AlpacaEnvironment | None = None,
+        fingerprint: str | None = None,
+        reconnect_policy: ReconnectPolicy | None = None,
+        sleep: Callable[[float], Awaitable[None] | None] | None = None,
+        rng: Callable[[], float] | None = None,
+        clock: Callable[[], datetime] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(credentials, AlpacaCredentials):
+            raise TypeError("credentials must be AlpacaCredentials")
+        if not callable(getattr(transport, "connect", None)):
+            raise TypeError("transport must expose connect(url)")
+        resolved_environment = environment or credentials.environment
+        if not isinstance(resolved_environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
+            raise TypeError("environment must be an AlpacaEnvironment")
+        if resolved_environment is not credentials.environment:
+            raise EnvironmentMismatchError(
+                "stream environment does not match credential environment"
+            )
+        resolved_fingerprint = fingerprint or credential_fingerprint(credentials)
+        self._credentials = credentials
+        self._transport = transport
+        self._environment = resolved_environment
+        self._fingerprint = _require_text(resolved_fingerprint, field="fingerprint")
+        self._policy = reconnect_policy or ReconnectPolicy()
+        if not isinstance(self._policy, ReconnectPolicy):
+            raise TypeError("reconnect_policy must be ReconnectPolicy")
+        self._sleep = sleep or asyncio.sleep
+        if not callable(self._sleep):
+            raise TypeError("sleep must be callable")
+        self._rng = rng or random.random
+        if not callable(self._rng):
+            raise TypeError("rng must be callable")
+        self._clock = clock or (lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
+        if not callable(self._clock):
+            raise TypeError("clock must be callable")
+
+    @property
+    def environment(self) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
+        return self._environment
+
+    @property
+    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
+        return self._fingerprint
+
+    def normalize(self, message: Mapping[str, Any] | str | bytes) -> TradeUpdate:
+        return TradeUpdate.from_message(
+            message, environment=self._environment, fingerprint=self._fingerprint
+        )
+
+    def __aiter__(self) -> AsyncIterator[TradeUpdate | StreamReconnected]:
+        return self.events()
+
+    async def events(self) -> AsyncIterator[TradeUpdate | StreamReconnected]:
+        """Yield updates forever, making every recovered disconnect explicit."""
+
+        connection = await self._open_and_subscribe()
+        last_seen: datetime | None = None
+        try:
+            while True:
+                try:
+                    message = await self._receive(connection)
+                except (ConnectionError, EOFError, OSError, StopAsyncIteration) as exc:
+                    await self._close(connection)
+                    connection = await self._reconnect(exc)
+                    marker_time = self._clock()
+                    if marker_time.tzinfo is None or marker_time.utcoffset() is None:
+                        raise ValueError(
+                            "clock must return a timezone-aware datetime"
+                        ) from None
+                    yield StreamReconnected(
+                        environment=self._environment,
+                        fingerprint=self._fingerprint,
+                        attempt=self._last_reconnect_attempt,
+                        reconnected_at=marker_time.astimezone(UTC),
+                        last_seen_timestamp=last_seen,
+                    )
+                    continue
+                update = self.normalize(message)
+                last_seen = update.timestamp
+                yield update
+        finally:
+            await self._close(connection)
+
+    async def _reconnect(self, original: BaseException) -> Any:
+        last_error: BaseException = original
+        for attempt in range(1, self._policy.max_attempts + 1):
+            delay = self._policy.delay_for_attempt(attempt, self._rng)
+            await _maybe_await(self._sleep(delay))
+            try:
+                connection = await self._open_and_subscribe()
+            except StreamAuthError:
+                raise
+            except (ConnectionError, EOFError, OSError, StopAsyncIteration) as exc:
+                last_error = exc
+                continue
+            self._last_reconnect_attempt = attempt
+            return connection
+        raise last_error
+
+    async def _open_and_subscribe(self) -> Any:
+        connection = await _maybe_await(
+            self._transport.connect(self._environment.trade_stream_url)
+        )
+        if connection is None:
+            connection = self._transport
+        await self._send(
+            connection,
+            {
+                "action": "auth",
+                "key": self._credentials.key_id,
+                "secret": self._credentials.secret_key,
+            },
+        )
+        auth_response = _decode_message(await self._receive(connection))
+        auth_data = auth_response.get("data")
+        authorized = (
+            auth_response.get("stream") == "authorization"
+            and isinstance(auth_data, Mapping)
+            and str(auth_data.get("status", "")).lower() == "authorized"
+        )
+        if not authorized:
+            raise StreamAuthError(
+                "Alpaca trade_updates authentication failed", response=auth_response
+            )
+        await self._send(
+            connection,
+            {"action": "listen", "data": {"streams": ["trade_updates"]}},
+        )
+        listen_response = _decode_message(await self._receive(connection))
+        listen_data = listen_response.get("data")
+        if listen_response.get("stream") == "authorization":
+            raise StreamAuthError(
+                "Alpaca rejected the trade_updates listen request",
+                response=listen_response,
+            )
+        streams = listen_data.get("streams") if isinstance(listen_data, Mapping) else None
+        if listen_response.get("stream") != "listening" or not isinstance(streams, list):
+            raise StreamAuthError(
+                "Alpaca did not acknowledge the trade_updates subscription",
+                response=listen_response,
+            )
+        if "trade_updates" not in streams:
+            raise StreamAuthError(
+                "Alpaca listening acknowledgement omitted trade_updates",
+                response=listen_response,
+            )
+        return connection
+
+    @staticmethod
+    async def _send(connection: Any, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
+        if callable(getattr(connection, "send_json", None)):
+            await _maybe_await(connection.send_json(dict(payload)))
+            return
+        if callable(getattr(connection, "send", None)):
+            await _maybe_await(connection.send(json.dumps(payload)))
+            return
+        raise TypeError("websocket connection must expose send_json() or send()")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    async def _receive(connection: Any) -> Any:
+        for name in ("receive_json", "recv_json", "receive", "recv"):
+            method = getattr(connection, name, None)
+            if callable(method):
+                return await _maybe_await(method())
+        raise TypeError(
+            "websocket connection must expose receive_json(), recv_json(), receive(), or recv()"
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    async def _close(connection: Any) -> None:
+        close = getattr(connection, "close", None)
+        if callable(close):
+            await _maybe_await(close())
+
+
+async def _maybe_await(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+        return await value
+    return value

+"""Bounded, read-only normalization of Alpaca account activities.
+
+The service deliberately accepts an injected ``get`` client.  It therefore
+contains no networking of its own and is safe to exercise with fixture-only
+clients.  Numeric provider fields are converted to :class:`~decimal.Decimal`
+and every returned activity is scoped to an Alpaca environment and account
+fingerprint.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from datetime import date as Date
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.auth import AlpacaEnvironment
+
+__all__ = [
+    "AlpacaActivityService",
+    "FillActivity",
+    "FeeActivity",
+    "CorporateActivity",
+    "UnknownActivity",
+    "activity_idempotency_key",
+    "dedupe_activities",
+]
+
+_FEE_TYPES = frozenset(
+    {
+        "FEE",
+        "CFEE",
+        "PTC",
+        "PTR",
+        # Some feeds report the fee subtype directly as the activity type.
+        "TAF",
+        "REG",
+        "SEC",
+        "CAT",
+        "ORF",
+        "OCC",
+        "NRV",
+        "NRC",
+        "LCT",
+    }
+)
+_DIVIDEND_TYPES = frozenset(
+    {
+        "DIV",
+        "CGD",
+        "DIVCGL",
+        "DIVCGS",
+        "DIVFEE",
+        "DIVFT",
+        "DIVNRA",
+        "DIVROC",
+        "DIVTW",
+        "DIVTXEX",
+    }
+)
+_CORPORATE_TYPES = frozenset(
+    {
+        "SPLIT",
+        "SSP",
+        "SPIN",
+        "SSO",
+        "MA",
+        "NC",
+        "SC",
+        "REO",
+        "REORG",
+        "ACATS",
+        "FOPT",
+        "OPCA",
+        "OPASN",
+        "OPEXP",
+        "OPXRC",
+    }
+)
+
+
+def _require_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(value: Any, *, field: str, optional: bool = False) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        if optional:
+            return None
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is required")
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        result = value
+    elif isinstance(value, int):
+        result = Decimal(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            result = Decimal(value.strip())
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if not result.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    return result
+
+
+def _timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty timestamp or date")
+    text = value.strip()
+    if len(text) == 10:
+        try:
+            parsed_date = Date.fromisoformat(text)
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid date") from None
+        return datetime.combine(parsed_date, datetime.min.time(), tzinfo=UTC)
+    if text.endswith("Z"):
+        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _activity_time(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> datetime:
+    for name in ("transaction_time", "executed_at", "at", "date", "settle_date"):
+        if data.get(name) is not None:
+            return _timestamp(data[name], field=name)
+    raise ValueError("activity has no transaction_time or date")
+
+
+def _optional_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    return _require_text(value, field=field)
+
+
+def activity_idempotency_key(
+    activity_id: str,
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment | str,
+    fingerprint: str | None = None,
+    *,
+    account_fingerprint: str | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    """Return a stable scope-qualified key for one broker activity ID."""
+
+    broker_id = _require_text(activity_id, field="activity_id")
+    raw_environment = getattr(environment, "value", environment)
+    environment_name = _require_text(raw_environment, field="environment").upper()
+    if environment_name not in {member.value for member in AlpacaEnvironment}:
+        raise ValueError(f"unsupported Alpaca environment: {environment_name!r}")
+    if fingerprint is not None and account_fingerprint is not None:
+        if fingerprint != account_fingerprint:
+            raise ValueError("fingerprint and account_fingerprint disagree")
+    scope = fingerprint if fingerprint is not None else account_fingerprint
+    resolved_fingerprint = _require_text(scope, field="fingerprint")
+    # Length prefixes make the representation unambiguous while retaining the
+    # broker ID and account scope for operator inspection.
+    return (
+        f"alpaca:{len(environment_name)}:{environment_name}:"
+        f"{len(resolved_fingerprint)}:{resolved_fingerprint}:"
+        f"{len(broker_id)}:{broker_id}"
+    )
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class FillActivity:
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    idempotency_key: str
+    id: str
+    order_id: str
+    symbol: str
+    side: str
+    qty: Decimal
+    cum_qty: Decimal
+    leaves_qty: Decimal
+    price: Decimal
+    transaction_time: datetime
+    type: str
+    activity_type: str = "FILL"
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class FeeActivity:
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    idempotency_key: str
+    id: str
+    activity_type: str
+    amount: Decimal
+    transaction_time: datetime
+    symbol: str | None = None
+    qty: Decimal | None = None
+    price: Decimal | None = None
+    description: str | None = None
+    activity_sub_type: str | None = None
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CorporateActivity:
+    """A dividend or position-changing corporate action.
+
+    Corporate actions have heterogeneous payloads.  Common numeric values are
+    normalized explicitly and ``amounts`` preserves any additional documented
+    amount/quantity/price fields as Decimal values.
+    """
+
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    idempotency_key: str
+    id: str
+    activity_type: str
+    transaction_time: datetime
+    symbol: str | None = None
+    amount: Decimal | None = None
+    qty: Decimal | None = None
+    price: Decimal | None = None
+    per_share_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    description: str | None = None
+    activity_sub_type: str | None = None
+    is_dividend: bool = False
+    amounts: Mapping[str, Decimal] | None = None
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class UnknownActivity:
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    idempotency_key: str
+    id: str
+    activity_type: str
+    transaction_time: datetime | None
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any]
+
+
+NormalizedActivity = FillActivity | FeeActivity | CorporateActivity | UnknownActivity
+
+
+def dedupe_activities(activities: Iterable[NormalizedActivity]) -> list[NormalizedActivity]:
+    """Pure, stable-order deduplication by normalized idempotency key."""
+
+    result: list[NormalizedActivity] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for activity in activities:
+        key = activity.idempotency_key
+        if key not in seen:
+            seen.add(key)
+            result.append(activity)
+    return result
+
+
+def _all_decimal_fields(data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
+    markers = ("amount", "qty", "quantity", "price", "cash", "rate", "ratio", "fee")
+    values: dict[str, Decimal] = {}
+    for name, value in data.items():
+        if value is None or not any(marker in name.lower() for marker in markers):
+            continue
+        try:
+            parsed = _decimal(value, field=name, optional=True)
+        except ValueError:
+            continue
+        if parsed is not None:
+            values[name] = parsed
+    return values
+
+
+class AlpacaActivityService:
+    """Read and normalize bounded pages from ``GET /v2/account/activities``."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        client: Any,
+        *,
+        environment: AlpacaEnvironment | None = None,
+        fingerprint: str | None = None,
+        page_size: int = 100,
+        max_pages: int = 10,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not callable(getattr(client, "get", None)):
+            raise TypeError("client must expose get(path, params=...)")
+        resolved_environment = environment or getattr(client, "environment", None)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
+            raise TypeError("environment must be supplied or exposed by the client")
+        resolved_fingerprint = fingerprint or getattr(client, "fingerprint", None)
+        if not isinstance(resolved_fingerprint, str) or not resolved_fingerprint.strip():
+            raise ValueError("fingerprint must be supplied or exposed by the client")
+        self._validate_page_size(page_size)
+        self._validate_max_pages(max_pages)
+        self._client = client
+        self._environment = resolved_environment
+        self._fingerprint = resolved_fingerprint.strip()
+        self._page_size = page_size
+        self._max_pages = max_pages
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_page_size(page_size: int) -> None:
+        if (
+            isinstance(page_size, bool)
+            or not isinstance(page_size, int)
+            or not 1 <= page_size <= 100
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("page_size must be an int from 1 through 100")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_max_pages(max_pages: int) -> None:
+        if isinstance(max_pages, bool) or not isinstance(max_pages, int) or max_pages < 1:
+            raise ValueError("max_pages must be an int >= 1")
+
+    @property
+    def environment(self) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
+        return self._environment
+
+    @property
+    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
+        return self._fingerprint
+
+    def normalize_activity(self, data: Mapping[str, Any]) -> NormalizedActivity:
+        if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("activity must be a JSON object")
+        activity_id = _require_text(data.get("id"), field="id")
+        activity_type = _require_text(data.get("activity_type"), field="activity_type").upper()
+        idempotency_key = activity_idempotency_key(
+            activity_id, self._environment, self._fingerprint
+        )
+        raw = dict(data)
+        if activity_type == "FILL":
+            fill_type = _require_text(data.get("type"), field="type").lower()
+            if fill_type not in {"fill", "partial_fill"}:
+                raise ValueError(f"unsupported FILL type: {fill_type!r}")
+            return FillActivity(
+                environment=self._environment,
+                fingerprint=self._fingerprint,
+                idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
+                id=activity_id,
+                order_id=_require_text(data.get("order_id"), field="order_id"),
+                symbol=_require_text(data.get("symbol"), field="symbol").upper(),
+                side=_require_text(data.get("side"), field="side").lower(),
+                qty=_decimal(data.get("qty"), field="qty"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                cum_qty=_decimal(data.get("cum_qty"), field="cum_qty"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                leaves_qty=_decimal(data.get("leaves_qty"), field="leaves_qty"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                price=_decimal(data.get("price"), field="price"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                transaction_time=_activity_time(data),
+                type=fill_type,
+                raw=raw,
+            )
+
+        amount = data.get("net_amount", data.get("amount", data.get("fee")))
+        if activity_type in _FEE_TYPES:
+            return FeeActivity(
+                environment=self._environment,
+                fingerprint=self._fingerprint,
+                idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
+                id=activity_id,
+                activity_type=activity_type,
+                amount=_decimal(amount, field="net_amount"),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                transaction_time=_activity_time(data),
+                symbol=_optional_text(data.get("symbol"), field="symbol"),
+                qty=_decimal(data.get("qty"), field="qty", optional=True),
+                price=_decimal(data.get("price"), field="price", optional=True),
+                description=_optional_text(data.get("description"), field="description"),
+                activity_sub_type=_optional_text(
+                    data.get("activity_sub_type", data.get("activity_subtype")),
+                    field="activity_sub_type",
+                ),
+                raw=raw,
+            )
+
+        if activity_type in _DIVIDEND_TYPES | _CORPORATE_TYPES:
+            symbol = _optional_text(data.get("symbol"), field="symbol")
+            return CorporateActivity(
+                environment=self._environment,
+                fingerprint=self._fingerprint,
+                idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
+                id=activity_id,
+                activity_type=activity_type,
+                transaction_time=_activity_time(data),
+                symbol=None if symbol is None else symbol.upper(),
+                amount=_decimal(amount, field="net_amount", optional=True),
+                qty=_decimal(data.get("qty"), field="qty", optional=True),
+                price=_decimal(data.get("price"), field="price", optional=True),
+                per_share_amount=_decimal(
+                    data.get("per_share_amount"), field="per_share_amount", optional=True
+                ),
+                description=_optional_text(data.get("description"), field="description"),
+                activity_sub_type=_optional_text(
+                    data.get("activity_sub_type", data.get("activity_subtype")),
+                    field="activity_sub_type",
+                ),
+                is_dividend=activity_type in _DIVIDEND_TYPES,
+                amounts=_all_decimal_fields(data),
+                raw=raw,
+            )
+
+        return UnknownActivity(
+            environment=self._environment,
+            fingerprint=self._fingerprint,
+            idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
+            id=activity_id,
+            activity_type=activity_type,
+            transaction_time=(
+                _activity_time(data)
+                if any(
+                    data.get(name) is not None
+                    for name in ("transaction_time", "executed_at", "at", "date", "settle_date")
+                )
+                else None
+            ),
+            raw=raw,
+        )
+
+    def list_activities(
+        self,
+        *,
+        activity_types: str | Sequence[str] | None = None,
+        activity_type: str | None = None,
+        date: str | Date | datetime | None = None,
+        after: str | Date | datetime | None = None,
+        until: str | Date | datetime | None = None,
+        direction: str | None = None,
+        order_id: str | None = None,
+        page_size: int | None = None,
+        max_pages: int | None = None,
+    ) -> list[NormalizedActivity]:
+        """Read activities using page tokens, stopping at the hard page cap."""
+
+        if activity_types is not None and activity_type is not None:
+            raise ValueError("pass activity_types or activity_type, not both")
+        resolved_page_size = self._page_size if page_size is None else page_size
+        resolved_max_pages = self._max_pages if max_pages is None else max_pages
+        self._validate_page_size(resolved_page_size)
+        self._validate_max_pages(resolved_max_pages)
+        if resolved_max_pages > self._max_pages:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"max_pages cannot exceed the configured hard cap of {self._max_pages}"
+            )
+        params: dict[str, Any] = {"page_size": resolved_page_size}
+        chosen_types: str | Sequence[str] | None = (
+            activity_types if activity_types is not None else activity_type
+        )
+        if chosen_types is not None:
+            if isinstance(chosen_types, str):
+                normalized_types = _require_text(chosen_types, field="activity_types").upper()
+            else:
+                normalized_types = ",".join(
+                    _require_text(item, field="activity_types item").upper()
+                    for item in chosen_types
+                )
+                if not normalized_types:
+                    raise ValueError("activity_types must not be empty")
+            params["activity_types"] = normalized_types
+        for name, value in (("date", date), ("after", after), ("until", until)):
+            if value is not None:
+                params[name] = self._format_filter(value, field=name)
+        if direction is not None:
+            normalized_direction = _require_text(direction, field="direction").lower()
+            if normalized_direction not in {"asc", "desc"}:
+                raise ValueError("direction must be 'asc' or 'desc'")
+            params["direction"] = normalized_direction
+        if order_id is not None:
+            params["order_id"] = _require_text(order_id, field="order_id")
+
+        result: list[NormalizedActivity] = []
+        previous_token: str | None = None
+        for _page_number in range(resolved_max_pages):
+            response = self._client.get("/v2/account/activities", params=dict(params))
+            items, explicit_token = self._page(response)
+            result.extend(self.normalize_activity(item) for item in items)
+            if explicit_token is not None:
+                next_token = explicit_token
+            elif len(items) < resolved_page_size:
+                break
+            elif items:
+                next_token = _require_text(items[-1].get("id"), field="last activity id")
+            else:
+                break
+            if next_token == previous_token:
+                raise ValueError("activity pagination repeated a page token")
+            previous_token = next_token
+            params["page_token"] = next_token
+        return result
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _format_filter(value: str | Date | datetime, *, field: str) -> str:
+        if isinstance(value, datetime):
+            if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{field} datetime must be timezone-aware")
+            return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")
+        if isinstance(value, Date):
+            return value.isoformat()
+        return _require_text(value, field=field)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _page(response: Any) -> tuple[list[Mapping[str, Any]], str | None]:
+        token: str | None = None
+        if isinstance(response, list):
+            items = response
+        elif isinstance(response, Mapping):
+            candidate = response.get("activities", response.get("data"))
+            if not isinstance(candidate, list):
+                raise ValueError("activity response object must contain an activities array")
+            items = candidate
+            raw_token = response.get("next_page_token")
+            if raw_token is not None:
+                token = _require_text(raw_token, field="next_page_token")
+        else:
+            raise ValueError("GET /v2/account/activities must return a JSON array")
+        if not all(isinstance(item, Mapping) for item in items):
+            raise ValueError("account activity entries must be JSON objects")
+        return items, token

+"""Normalize Alpaca ``trade_updates`` and manage a read-only stream session.
+
+The websocket transport is injected and intentionally tiny, allowing contract
+tests to replay JSON without opening a socket.  This module sends only Alpaca's
+authentication and ``listen`` frames; it has no order mutation operations.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import inspect
+import json
+import math
+import random
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Awaitable, Callable, Mapping
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Any
+
+from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.auth import (
+    AlpacaCredentials,
+    AlpacaEnvironment,
+    EnvironmentMismatchError,
+    credential_fingerprint,
+)

+from mike_trade.domain.errors import BrokerError
+
+__all__ = [
+    "TradeUpdate",
+    "TradeUpdateEvent",
+    "TradeUpdateStream",
+    "StreamReconnected",

+    "ReconnectPolicy",
+]
+
+

+    ACCEPTED = "accepted"
+    PENDING_NEW = "pending_new"
+    PARTIAL_FILL = "partial_fill"
+    FILL = "fill"
+    REJECTED = "rejected"
+    CANCELED = "canceled"
+    EXPIRED = "expired"
+    REPLACED = "replaced"
+    PENDING_CANCEL = "pending_cancel"

+    STOPPED = "stopped"

+
+
+_KNOWN_EVENTS = {

+    for member in TradeUpdateEvent
+    if member is not TradeUpdateEvent.UNKNOWN
+}
+
+
+def _require_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _optional_text(value: Any, *, field: str) -> str | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    return _require_text(value, field=field)
+
+
+def _decimal(value: Any, *, field: str) -> Decimal | None:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        result = value
+    elif isinstance(value, int):
+        result = Decimal(value)
+    elif isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            result = Decimal(value.strip())
+        except InvalidOperation:
+            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal") from None
+    else:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str")
+    if not result.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    return result
+
+
+def _timestamp(value: Any, *, field: str = "timestamp") -> datetime:
+    text = _require_text(value, field=field)
+    if text.endswith("Z"):
+        text = text[:-1] + "+00:00"
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid timestamp") from None
+    if parsed.tzinfo is None or parsed.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
+    return parsed.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _environment(value: Any) -> AlpacaEnvironment:

+
+def _decode_message(message: Any) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    if isinstance(message, bytes):
+        message = message.decode("utf-8")
+    if isinstance(message, str):
+        try:
+            message = json.loads(message, parse_float=Decimal, parse_int=Decimal)
+        except (json.JSONDecodeError, UnicodeDecodeError):
+            raise ValueError("websocket message is not valid JSON") from None
+    if not isinstance(message, Mapping):
+        raise ValueError("websocket message must be a JSON object")
+    return message
+
+
+def _payload(message: Mapping[str, Any]) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
+    stream_name = message.get("stream", message.get("T"))
+    data = message.get("data")
+    if stream_name == "trade_updates":
+        if data is None:
+            return message
+        if not isinstance(data, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("trade_updates data must be a JSON object")
+        return data
+    # Accept an already-unwrapped fixture or transport payload.
+    if "event" in message and "order" in message:
+        return message
+    raise ValueError("message is not a trade_updates event")
+
+
+def _assert_message_scope(
+    message: Mapping[str, Any],
+    data: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment,
+    fingerprint: str,
+) -> None:
+    order = data.get("order")
+    sources = [message, data]
+    if isinstance(order, Mapping):
+        sources.append(order)
+    for source in sources:
+        for name in ("environment", "account_environment", "source_environment"):
+            if source.get(name) is not None and _environment(source[name]) is not environment:
+                raise EnvironmentMismatchError(
+                    f"trade update environment {source[name]!r} does not match "
+                    f"session environment {environment.value}"
+                )
+        for name in ("fingerprint", "account_fingerprint"):
+            if source.get(name) is not None and source[name] != fingerprint:
+                raise EnvironmentMismatchError(
+                    "trade update account fingerprint does not match stream session"
+                )
+

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class TradeUpdate:
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    event: TradeUpdateEvent
+    raw_event: str
+    order: AlpacaOrder
+    timestamp: datetime
+    execution_id: str | None = None
+    price: Decimal | None = None
+    qty: Decimal | None = None
+    position_qty: Decimal | None = None
+    reason: str | None = None
+    raw: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_message(
+        cls,
+        message: Mapping[str, Any] | str | bytes,
+        *,
+        environment: AlpacaEnvironment,
+        fingerprint: str,
+    ) -> TradeUpdate:
+        """Normalize one envelope (or already-unwrapped) trade update."""
+
+        if not isinstance(environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
+            raise TypeError("environment must be an AlpacaEnvironment")
+        resolved_fingerprint = _require_text(fingerprint, field="fingerprint")
+        envelope = _decode_message(message)
+        data = _payload(envelope)
+        _assert_message_scope(
+            envelope,
+            data,
+            environment=environment,
+            fingerprint=resolved_fingerprint,
+        )
+        raw_event = _require_text(data.get("event"), field="event").lower()
+        event = _KNOWN_EVENTS.get(raw_event, TradeUpdateEvent.UNKNOWN)
+        raw_order = data.get("order")
+        if not isinstance(raw_order, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("trade update order must be a JSON object")
+        return cls(
+            environment=environment,
+            fingerprint=resolved_fingerprint,
+            event=event,
+            raw_event=raw_event,
+            order=_normalize_order(raw_order, environment=environment),
+            timestamp=_timestamp(data.get("timestamp")),
+            execution_id=_optional_text(data.get("execution_id"), field="execution_id"),
+            price=_decimal(data.get("price"), field="price"),
+            qty=_decimal(data.get("qty"), field="qty"),
+            position_qty=_decimal(data.get("position_qty"), field="position_qty"),
+            reason=_optional_text(data.get("reason"), field="reason"),
+            raw=dict(envelope),
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def is_unknown(self) -> bool:
+        return self.event is TradeUpdateEvent.UNKNOWN
+
+    @property
+    def incremental_qty(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        """Execution quantity in this message (distinct from order.filled_qty)."""
+
+        return self.qty
+
+    @property
+    def cumulative_qty(self) -> Decimal | None:
+        return self.order.filled_qty
+

+class StreamAuthError(BrokerError):
+    """Alpaca rejected websocket authentication or the listen request."""
+
+    def __init__(self, message: str, *, response: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
+        self.response = None if response is None else dict(response)
+        super().__init__(message, code="alpaca_stream_auth", context={})

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ReconnectPolicy:
+    """Maximum reconnect attempts and bounded exponential delay with jitter."""
+
+    max_attempts: int = 5
+    base_delay_seconds: float = 0.5
+    max_delay_seconds: float = 8.0
+    jitter_ratio: float = 0.25
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if isinstance(self.max_attempts, bool) or not isinstance(self.max_attempts, int):
+            raise ValueError("max_attempts must be an int >= 1")
+        if self.max_attempts < 1:
+            raise ValueError("max_attempts must be an int >= 1")
+        for name in ("base_delay_seconds", "max_delay_seconds", "jitter_ratio"):
+            value = getattr(self, name)
+            if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite non-negative number")
+            if not math.isfinite(float(value)) or value < 0:
+                raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a finite non-negative number")
+        if self.max_delay_seconds < self.base_delay_seconds:
+            raise ValueError("max_delay_seconds must be >= base_delay_seconds")
+        if self.jitter_ratio > 1:
+            raise ValueError("jitter_ratio must be <= 1")
+
+    def delay_for_attempt(
+        self, attempt: int, rng: Callable[[], float] | None = None
+    ) -> float:
+        if isinstance(attempt, bool) or not isinstance(attempt, int) or attempt < 1:
+            raise ValueError("attempt must be an int >= 1")
+        base = min(
+            float(self.max_delay_seconds),
+            float(self.base_delay_seconds) * (2.0 ** (attempt - 1)),
+        )
+        if rng is not None and self.jitter_ratio:
+            draw = float(rng())
+            if not math.isfinite(draw) or not 0 <= draw <= 1:
+                raise ValueError("rng must return a finite value from 0 through 1")
+            base *= 1.0 + float(self.jitter_ratio) * (2.0 * draw - 1.0)
+        return max(0.0, min(float(self.max_delay_seconds), base))
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class StreamReconnected:
+    """Explicit gap marker: REST reconciliation is required after reconnect."""
+
+    environment: AlpacaEnvironment
+    fingerprint: str
+    attempt: int
+    reconnected_at: datetime
+    last_seen_timestamp: datetime | None
+    event: str = "gap"
+    requires_reconciliation: bool = True
+    reconcile: tuple[str, ...] = (
+        "open_orders",
+        "orders_by_client_order_id",
+        "activities_since_last_seen",
+    )
+
+    @property
+    def gap_since(self) -> datetime | None:
+        return self.last_seen_timestamp

+class TradeUpdateStream:
+    """Authenticate, listen, normalize, and reconnect an injected transport."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        credentials: AlpacaCredentials,
+        transport: Any,
+        *,
+        environment: AlpacaEnvironment | None = None,
+        fingerprint: str | None = None,
+        reconnect_policy: ReconnectPolicy | None = None,
+        sleep: Callable[[float], Awaitable[None] | None] | None = None,
+        rng: Callable[[], float] | None = None,
+        clock: Callable[[], datetime] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(credentials, AlpacaCredentials):
+            raise TypeError("credentials must be AlpacaCredentials")
+        if not callable(getattr(transport, "connect", None)):
+            raise TypeError("transport must expose connect(url)")
+        resolved_environment = environment or credentials.environment
+        if not isinstance(resolved_environment, AlpacaEnvironment):
+            raise TypeError("environment must be an AlpacaEnvironment")
+        if resolved_environment is not credentials.environment:
+            raise EnvironmentMismatchError(
+                "stream environment does not match credential environment"
+            )
+        resolved_fingerprint = fingerprint or credential_fingerprint(credentials)
+        self._credentials = credentials
+        self._transport = transport
+        self._environment = resolved_environment
+        self._fingerprint = _require_text(resolved_fingerprint, field="fingerprint")
+        self._policy = reconnect_policy or ReconnectPolicy()
+        if not isinstance(self._policy, ReconnectPolicy):
+            raise TypeError("reconnect_policy must be ReconnectPolicy")
+        self._sleep = sleep or asyncio.sleep
+        if not callable(self._sleep):
+            raise TypeError("sleep must be callable")
+        self._rng = rng or random.random
+        if not callable(self._rng):
+            raise TypeError("rng must be callable")
+        self._clock = clock or (lambda: datetime.now(UTC))
+        if not callable(self._clock):
+            raise TypeError("clock must be callable")
+
+    @property
+    def environment(self) -> AlpacaEnvironment:
+        return self._environment
+
+    @property
+    def fingerprint(self) -> str:
+        return self._fingerprint
+
+    def normalize(self, message: Mapping[str, Any] | str | bytes) -> TradeUpdate:
+        return TradeUpdate.from_message(
+            message, environment=self._environment, fingerprint=self._fingerprint
+        )
+
+    def __aiter__(self) -> AsyncIterator[TradeUpdate | StreamReconnected]:
+        return self.events()
+
+    async def events(self) -> AsyncIterator[TradeUpdate | StreamReconnected]:
+        """Yield updates forever, making every recovered disconnect explicit."""
+
+        connection = await self._open_and_subscribe()
+        last_seen: datetime | None = None
+        try:
+            while True:
+                try:
+                    message = await self._receive(connection)
+                except (ConnectionError, EOFError, OSError, StopAsyncIteration) as exc:
+                    await self._close(connection)
+                    connection = await self._reconnect(exc)
+                    marker_time = self._clock()
+                    if marker_time.tzinfo is None or marker_time.utcoffset() is None:
+                        raise ValueError(
+                            "clock must return a timezone-aware datetime"
+                        ) from None
+                    yield StreamReconnected(
+                        environment=self._environment,
+                        fingerprint=self._fingerprint,
+                        attempt=self._last_reconnect_attempt,
+                        reconnected_at=marker_time.astimezone(UTC),
+                        last_seen_timestamp=last_seen,
+                    )
+                    continue
+                update = self.normalize(message)
+                last_seen = update.timestamp
+                yield update
+        finally:
+            await self._close(connection)
+
+    async def _reconnect(self, original: BaseException) -> Any:
+        last_error: BaseException = original
+        for attempt in range(1, self._policy.max_attempts + 1):
+            delay = self._policy.delay_for_attempt(attempt, self._rng)
+            await _maybe_await(self._sleep(delay))
+            try:
+                connection = await self._open_and_subscribe()
+            except StreamAuthError:
+                raise
+            except (ConnectionError, EOFError, OSError, StopAsyncIteration) as exc:
+                last_error = exc
+                continue
+            self._last_reconnect_attempt = attempt
+            return connection
+        raise last_error
+
+    async def _open_and_subscribe(self) -> Any:
+        connection = await _maybe_await(
+            self._transport.connect(self._environment.trade_stream_url)
+        )
+        if connection is None:
+            connection = self._transport
+        await self._send(
+            connection,
+            {
+                "action": "auth",
+                "key": self._credentials.key_id,
+                "secret": self._credentials.secret_key,
+            },
+        )
+        auth_response = _decode_message(await self._receive(connection))
+        auth_data = auth_response.get("data")
+        authorized = (
+            auth_response.get("stream") == "authorization"
+            and isinstance(auth_data, Mapping)
+            and str(auth_data.get("status", "")).lower() == "authorized"
+        )
+        if not authorized:
+            raise StreamAuthError(
+                "Alpaca trade_updates authentication failed", response=auth_response
+            )
+        await self._send(
+            connection,
+            {"action": "listen", "data": {"streams": ["trade_updates"]}},
+        )
+        listen_response = _decode_message(await self._receive(connection))
+        listen_data = listen_response.get("data")
+        if listen_response.get("stream") == "authorization":
+            raise StreamAuthError(
+                "Alpaca rejected the trade_updates listen request",
+                response=listen_response,
+            )
+        streams = listen_data.get("streams") if isinstance(listen_data, Mapping) else None
+        if listen_response.get("stream") != "listening" or not isinstance(streams, list):
+            raise StreamAuthError(
+                "Alpaca did not acknowledge the trade_updates subscription",
+                response=listen_response,
+            )
+        if "trade_updates" not in streams:
+            raise StreamAuthError(
+                "Alpaca listening acknowledgement omitted trade_updates",
+                response=listen_response,
+            )
+        return connection
+
+    @staticmethod
+    async def _send(connection: Any, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None:
+        if callable(getattr(connection, "send_json", None)):
+            await _maybe_await(connection.send_json(dict(payload)))
+            return
+        if callable(getattr(connection, "send", None)):
+            await _maybe_await(connection.send(json.dumps(payload)))
+            return
+        raise TypeError("websocket connection must expose send_json() or send()")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    async def _receive(connection: Any) -> Any:
+        for name in ("receive_json", "recv_json", "receive", "recv"):
+            method = getattr(connection, name, None)
+            if callable(method):
+                return await _maybe_await(method())
+        raise TypeError(
+            "websocket connection must expose receive_json(), recv_json(), receive(), or recv()"
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    async def _close(connection: Any) -> None:
+        close = getattr(connection, "close", None)
+        if callable(close):
+            await _maybe_await(close())
+
+
+async def _maybe_await(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+        return await value
+    return value

+            "per_share_amount": "0.51",
+        }
+    )
+    split = service.normalize_activity(
+        {
+            "activity_type": "SPLIT",
+            "activity_sub_type": "FSPLIT",
+            "id": "split-1",
+            "date": "2026-10-08",
+            "symbol": "XYZ",
+            "qty": "20",
+            "net_amount": "0",
+        }
+    )
+    unknown = service.normalize_activity(
+        {
+            "activity_type": "FUTURE_KIND",
+            "id": "future-1",
+            "date": "2026-10-08",
+            "net_amount": "7.25",
+        }
+    )
+    assert isinstance(fill, FillActivity)
+    assert fill.type == "partial_fill"
+    assert fill.qty == Decimal("2.25")
+    assert fill.transaction_time.tzinfo is UTC
+    assert isinstance(fee, FeeActivity)
+    assert fee.amount == Decimal("-0.07")
+    assert fee.qty == Decimal("3.50")
